FILED s514b (Opus, 2026-10-10) from Fable's review probe ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s513/review/p514b/lslice.pl row lslice-neg-empty.  perl 5.40.3: `my @e; my @x = (@e)[-1]; print scalar @x` prints 0; PCL (main and s514b) prints 1.  MECHANISM: a one-index list subscript emits `(p-aref-deref SRC IDX)` with a SCALAR index -- the `$aref->[i]` hot path, which returns the element (undef) -- and at run time it is indistinguishable from `my @x = ($r->[0])`, which perl answers with ONE undef.  So the fix is COMPILE-TIME: in Pl/ExprToCL.pm gen_array_ref_access_form, a `list_ctx_subscript` node in LIST context (not lvalue) emits its index as `(vector IDX)`, which reaches #2953's empty-source arm.  Emission-changing (every one-index list slice in list context): measure corpus-diff and the slices bench row.  Guard: list-slice-01.t, perl-oracle rows for (@e)[0], (@e)[-1], (f())[0] with f returning (), and the unchanged (1)[5] (one undef) / $r->[0] in a list.

=== s543c (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-21, CODE 64353611) ===
VERDICT: LIVE -- (silent) `my @e; my @x = (@e)[-1]` perl 0 PCL 1 ; `(@e)[0]` 0/1 ; `()[0]` 0/1 ; `(empty())[0]` with `sub empty { () }` 0/1.
  Right: `(@e)[0, 1]` -> 0 ; `(1)[1]` and `(1, 2)[5]` -> 1 (perl too: a slice past the end of a NON-empty list keeps its undef).
MERGE: #3450 (s520a, the same rule in the argument slot) is closed INTO this task.  Its shapes, re-run here: `n((stat $f)[7])`,
  `n((g())[7])`, `n((stat $f)[7,8])`, `n((g())[0,1])` with `sub n { scalar @_ }` -> 0000 = perl (FIXED); `my @x = (stat $f)[7]` for a
  missing $f -> perl 0, PCL 1 -- this task's shape, kept here.
LABEL: silent (subject rewritten: it now carries #3450's surviving shape).
